SOUND & CREDITS

A familiar collection of sounds.

GeneralUser GS 1.471

SoundFont by S. Christian Collins, copyright 1997–2015. The bundled sound bank is Drew’s supplied GeneralUser GS collection. It includes the complete General MIDI instrument set and percussion, plus additional GS presets.

The audio engine

SoundFont synthesis and reverb: SpessaSynth Core 4.3.22, by Spessasus, Apache License 2.0. License.

MP3 encoding: lamejs 1.2.1, LGPL. License · Encoder source.

Optional compressed-bank decoder dependency: stb-vorbis. License. The bundled SF2 uses uncompressed samples.

The compositions

First Light in the Meadow, A Quiet Page, and Pocket Marimba are original example arrangements created for Drew Wichman’s music engine.

Your files

Composition files and rendered audio are processed in your browser. The last JSON composition can be recovered from browser storage. Download your song and finished audio to keep them across computers and sessions.
